policy: Microcosm-BE: synthetic Belgian population calibrated to Belgian administrative and national-accounts targets (sums of Chronicle facts; surveys validation-only). Support records: US survey donor pool, reweighted; a Belgian donor pool is the planned upgrade. All artifacts remain in the private Hugging Face repository. Builds publish there through microcosm-publish-release-build and the emitter, each into its own folder, releases/<release>/<build>/, which releases.json lists; making any artifact public is Max's decision. Builds are named by data_build_id, never ordinals.

licence.name: Microcosm US public synthetic donor release plus Belgian public aggregate facts
licence.notes: The donor is the immutable Build P artifact in source_stages.json. Chronicle owns licence evidence for destination facts. Repository visibility remains private pending Max's decision to make any of it public.

notes: Proposed target and policy year 2026 (BE-MC0), pending Max's ruling d1902. Microcosm-BE: synthetic Belgian population calibrated to Belgian administrative and national-accounts targets (sums of Chronicle facts; surveys validation-only). Support records: US survey donor pool, reweighted; a Belgian donor pool is the planned upgrade. source_coverage.json records source provenance, calibration_diagnostics.json records target fit, and reform_validation.json separates held-out comparisons. The existing private artifact and staging repository names are retained. A later release assembler and release qualification are required. releases.json names each release's current build and the repository's default release; only the emitter's release writer changes it, and no pointer file names a build.
